scope: Sweep every measured allocation inside the DXF OBJECTS callback for a generated AC1027 LAYOUT shadePlotMode=5 graph rooted to one RapidRT render-settings preset.

input.kind: Generated ASCII and Binary AC1027 DXF written by writeLayoutGraphControl under the test temporary directory, then imported before export.
input.sourceGraph: ACAD_LAYOUT root and Sheet A layout with shadePlotMode 5 -> a RapidRT render settings object, rooted through its named dictionary.
input.cleanup: The generated source and output DXFs are created under the system temporary directory and removed after the test.

implementation.method: Calibrate allocations performed during dx_iface::writeObjects, inject std::bad_alloc at every offset, require destination sentinel preservation and source graph retention, then retry the same adapter and import the resulting LAYOUT/render-settings graph.

validation.ascii: 57/57 calibrated callback allocation offsets injected; rollback, source graph preservation, same-adapter retry and readback passed.
validation.binary: 56/56 calibrated callback allocation offsets injected; rollback, source graph preservation, same-adapter retry and readback passed.

limitations: Generated transaction and graph-closure evidence only; no native rendering behavior or independent producer interoperability is established.
The control covers one AC1027 RapidRT preset profile, not all LAYOUT shade modes, render settings, OBJECTS builders, or whole-drawing failure states.
nextAction: Continue the P6 OBJECTS transaction-safety audit with an independent uncovered builder; keep producer semantics and platform qualification as separate gates.
